taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: gRPC reflection/schema visibility and its incremental confidentiality impact
controls.source_trace: Distinguish a discoverable descriptor from callable protected methods or genuinely confidential embedded options/comments. Resolve reflection authentication separately.
controls.implementation_branch: Reflection may intentionally publish a public schema; classify actual descriptor content before severity. Authentication interceptors may apply differently to reflection and business RPCs. A reflected method is inventory until the real principal can call it or confidential descriptor content itself is shown.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare the descriptor visible to an unauthenticated fixture client with intended public API documentation and a restricted method invocation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Reflection enabled or a method name exposed is not an authorization bypass; protected RPCs may still be correctly denied.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Restrict truly sensitive schema publication if required and preserve intended tooling; retest descriptors and RPC authority independently.
